name: Yayasan Chow Kit
summary: Protects at-risk children and youth in and around Chow Kit, Kuala Lumpur, giving them safe spaces and the support they need to reach their potential.
programmes: One-Stop Children's Centre (OSCC): protection and case management
Two drop-in centres in Chow Kit
A safe home for children needing temporary guardianship
beneficiaries: At-risk and marginalised children and teenagers in and around Chow Kit, Kuala Lumpur

organisation.founders: Dato' Dr Hartini Zainuddin, founder, with Raja Azizan and Kak Arfidah; the work began earlier as the Nur Salam children's programme under Yayasan Salam Malaysia before YCK was incorporated in 2010
organisation.leadership: Zakri Bin Mohd Khir (Chairman); Trustees: YAM Tunku Zain Al-'Abidin, Marlene Kaur, Prof. Dr Melati Nungsari, Francesco Caruso, Datin Shirieene Hajamaideen, Bhavanash Sharma
